tieu_de: Security Management Associate Open For Fresher
dia_chi_raw: Tầng 15, tòa Keangnam Landmark 72, Mễ Trì
mo_ta_cong_viec:
1. About the Position
We are looking for a Security Management Associate who is interested in Information Security and wants to build a professional career in the Security field. You will work with the Security Management team to support daily security operations, security compliance, information protection and security improvement activities.
Knowledge of information security principles is required. No prior professional experience is necessary, as training and guidance will be provided.
2. Key Responsibilities
Security Management
Support daily Information Security Management activities.
Support the implementation and management of security policies, procedures and guidelines.
Maintain security documents, records and reports.
Support regular security checks and follow-up activities.
 
Information Security & Privacy
Support information security and personal data protection activities.
Assist in monitoring compliance with security requirements.
Support security awareness and training programs.
Assist in managing security requirements for employees and external partners.
 
Security Inspection & Risk Management
Support regular security inspections and internal audits.
Identify potential security risks and follow up on corrective actions.
Support risk assessment and security improvement activities.
 
Incident Response
Support the reporting, tracking and documentation of security incidents.
Coordinate with relevant departments when security issues occur.
Participate in security drills and incident response activities.
 
Physical & Worksite Security
Support access control and security management at company sites.
Assist in managing CCTV, access control and other security systems.
Conduct basic security checks and report abnormal situations.
 
Other
Prepare security reports and management dashboards.
Support security projects and improvement initiatives.
Perform other security-related tasks assigned by the Security Manager.
4. What We Are Looking For
Interested in building a long-term career in Security.
Willing to learn both IT Security and Security Management.
Strong sense of responsibility and confidentiality.
Able to identify problems and proactively find solutions.
Comfortable working with different departments and stakeholders.
No need to know everything from day one — attitude and learning ability are more important.
3. Career Growth
Security Management Associate → Security Management Specialist → Security Manager / Security Expert
Possible career paths:
Information Security Management
Security Compliance
Privacy / Personal Data Protection
Security Audit & Risk Management
Security Incident Response
Physical Security Management
Security Architecture / Cybersecurity
 
4. Why Join Us?
Start your career in Security at a global IT company.
Work on real-world security management and compliance activities.
Learn from experienced Security professionals.
Receive on-the-job training and opportunities to develop technical skills.
Gain exposure to both IT Security and Physical Security.
Build a long-term career in the rapidly growing Security field.
 
If you are a fresh graduate who is curious about Security, willing to learn and ready to grow — we want to meet you.
yeu_cau:
Must Have
Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
Basic understanding of IT / Information Security.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
Responsible, careful and willing to learn.
Good communication and teamwork skills.
Ability to work with Microsoft Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint.
Nice to Have
Major in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, IT or related fields.
Understanding of basic security concepts such as Network & TCP/IP, Firewall, Endpoint Security, Access Control, CCTV / Physical Security and Security Incident Response.
Korean or English communication skills.
